methodNotes: User scope: collision constraints only; retain PCBF/CLF objectives, Fiala dynamics and existing initialization policy.

The ego set is represented explicitly by four vertices. The ordinary-distance dual uses an auxiliary hypograph scalar and four target multipliers. Fixed multipliers enter the existing yaw-linearized RTI rows. This is a finite-set interpretation of the published formula, not verification of author code.
Removed the signed-support overlap direction and the retired dual MEX call/build. Raw optimized multipliers are checked against independent primal distance without replacement or normalization.

An initial 1e-9 stopping setting rejected accurate coneprog -7 points; 1e-7 optimality stopping passed too early for a 1e-6-meter check at some distant poses. Final stopping tolerances are 1e-10 with a 1e-6-meter independent primal-dual check.

The previous crossing restoration-success assertion no longer holds: both final-geometry broad test and independent replay execute 17 of 19 requested holds, then return noOptimizationSolution. No signed-direction repair was reinstated. A focused hard-overlap infeasibility behavior replaces that outdated assertion; the failed scenario remains recorded.
No complete repository test suite or full avoidance/recovery campaign was run.
